name: The Last Train Home
source:
After a long day at work slaving away, finishing up the closing shift, you end up missing your train ride home.

While waiting for the next one to arrive, someone familiar appears on the platform.

[From [url=https://mirrormagic.itch.io/the-last-train-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一整天的辛苦工作，完成下班后，你最终错过了回家的火车。

在等待下一位到来的时候，站台上出现了一个熟悉的人。

[来自[url=https://mirrormagic.itch.io/the-last-train-home]itch.io[/url]]
